name: Young Silver Dragon
summary: A large silver dragon that breathes cold or paralyzing gas.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Paralyzing Breath.

actions.name: Cold Breath
actions.text: **.** *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* {dmg:11d8:cold}. *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *First Failure:* The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. *Second Failure:* The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
